meta.note: Program catalog for the recommendation engine. Eligibility rules are evaluated against per-customer usage features derived from AMI data (see backend/app/features.py). Benefit figures are illustrative estimates for the demo.

programs.name: EV Time-of-Day (Rate 195)
programs.description: Switch to the Super Off-Peak rate and charge your EV overnight (10 PM-6 AM) at a deeply discounted price.
programs.fit_template: You already use {night_pct}% of your energy overnight, so overnight EV charging would be cheap.

programs.name: Rooftop Solar + Net Metering
programs.description: Install rooftop solar and earn net-metering credits for energy you export to the grid.
programs.fit_template: Your daytime usage ({day_pct}%) and annual consumption make solar a strong payback candidate.

programs.name: Home Weatherization Rebate
programs.description: Rebates for insulation and air-sealing to cut heating and cooling waste.
programs.fit_template: Your usage swings {swing}x between seasons, a sign of heating/cooling loss weatherization can fix.

programs.name: Demand Response Events
programs.description: Get paid to reduce load during a handful of peak-demand events each summer.
programs.fit_template: You have high peak-hour usage ({peak_pct}%), so curtailing during events would earn meaningful credits.

programs.name: Budget Billing
programs.description: Even out seasonal bill swings into a predictable monthly amount.
programs.fit_template: Your bills swing {swing}x across the year; budget billing smooths that into one steady payment.

programs.name: Free Home Energy Assessment
programs.description: A free assessment identifying always-on and inefficient loads.
programs.fit_template: Your always-on load is {alwayson_pct}% of usage - higher than most similar homes.
